newsitem.title: USA: Burke Mills sees H2 97 sales equal H2 96.
newsitem.headline: Burke Mills sees H2 97 sales equal H2 96.

text.p: Burke Mills Inc, said Tuesday expected sales in the second half of this year to equal last year's first half, as it keeps experiencing softness in its automotive and upholstry segments.
Burke posted $20.4 million in sales in the second half of 1996.

The company Tuesday reported it earned $181,000 (or $0.07 a share) on sales of $10.4 million in the second quarter. This compared with a $26,000 net ($0.01 a share) on sales of $10.3 million the year before.
The company attributed the rise in net income for the quarter to improved efficiencies with its new dyeing equipment.
The company's stock traded unchanged at 2-5/8 Tuesday around noon.
